idea-plugin.name: Copy Path Tool
idea-plugin.description:
Quickly copy the path of the current file or selected code block from the editor context menu — designed for pasting into AI agent chats (ZCode, Kimi Work, Qoder Work, WorkBuddy, Trae Work, etc.) as context.

  • Copy File Disk Path — full disk path, e.g. D:/work/demo/src/App.java
  • Copy File Project Path — path relative to the project root, e.g. src/App.java
  • With code selected, the two items switch to Copy Code Block Disk Path / Copy Code Block Project Path and append the selected line range, e.g. src/App.java:12-34 (single line: src/App.java:12)

Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, GoLand, PhpStorm, WebStorm and all other IntelliJ Platform IDEs (2024.1+).

group.description: Copy disk or project-relative paths of files and code blocks (menu items switch with selection)
